otif_rules.on_time_result: Pass when actual_delivery_date <= promised_delivery_date; Fail when later; Needs verification when the delivery date is decision-critically uncertain
otif_rules.in_full_result: Pass when usable_received_qty >= ordered_qty; Fail when lower; Needs verification when receipt or rejection quantity is decision-critically uncertain
otif_rules.otif_result: Pass only when both components Pass; Fail when either component Fails; Needs verification when either component Needs verification

supplier_debit_status.Needs verification: eligible or posted value is decision-critically uncertain

expedite_component_status.Needs verification: authorization or invoice value is decision-critically uncertain

final_status_rules.Needs verification: A decision-critical field is uncertain, including supplier qualification, delivery date, receipt quantity, rejected quantity, debit eligibility, or posted debit
final_status_rules.Compliance hold: quality_hold_required=true or supplier_qualification_status is restricted or suspended
final_status_rules.Ready to close: none of the higher-precedence conditions applies
